---
title: "Sprott K System"
---

## Simulation

The governing equations of this chaotic system are

$$
\begin{eqnarray}
\dot{x} &=& xy+z\\
\dot{y} &=& x-y\\
\dot{z} &=& -x+az
\end{eqnarray}
$$

with $a=0.3$ and initial condition $(-1,-1,0)$.
